Balancer V1 pool exploited for ~$234k after an attacker used a rounding flaw to mint cheap BPT once WBTC reserves were compressed to dust
Source

tweet.text:
🚨SlowMist TI Alert🚨

💸 @Balancer Loss: ~234k USD

🔍 Root Cause: Balancer V1 BPool `joinswapPoolAmountOut` lets caller specify BPT output while `calcSingleInGivenPoolOut` reverse-computes input via 18-decimal fixed-point math. After attacker compressed WBTC reserves to dust via public swaps, the computed input rounded down to 1 satoshi WBTC yet full BPT was minted. Missing: minimum effective input, minimum pool balance, and relative-error validation; `MIN_BALANCE` only enforced in `bind/rebind`.

📌 Attacker: 0x338c7ec9befbb451d66fd8a468c32184f5689a41
📌 Attack Contract: 0x9caa8d0e44b22f50057d2f4
